newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai Ind to place about 140 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Ind to place about 140 mln shrs.

text.p: Shanghai Industrial Holdings Ltd is placing about 140 million new shares at HK$34.18 per share, and its parent would take up 65 percent of the new issue, joint placing agent BZW Asia said on Wednesday.

BZW said Shanghai Industrial's ultimate holding company, Shanghai Industrial Investment (Holdings) Co Ltd (SIIC), would take up 65 percent of the issue and the remaining 35 percent would be placed to institutional investors.
BZW and Peregrine are joint placing agent of the issue.
The issue will raise about US$600 million, BZW said.
Shanghai Industrial shares ended HK$0.80 or 2.31 percent up at HK$35.50 on Wednesday.
